steps.label: Start
steps.note:
Phase starts with 18s debuffs going out to random party members (2 stay blank), & soon after the center becomes unsafe, plus 3 hands spawn in a Triangle shape.
 -High Powered Sniper Cannon(White) - Pair Stack(White+Blank)
 -Sniper Cannon Fodder(Purp) - Spread AOE

Lineup conga-style to find who's going where.

NOTE: Due to game limits, certain team comps will cap the status limit(incl.FC buffs) during Hello World. Take care to limit fc-buffs & jobs w/ extra buffs at this time.

steps.label: Transition Setup1
steps.note: Purples move forward, & you'll be counted 1-4 Left->Right. Whites move back, & simply assign Left or Right. Blanks will stay still & also assign Left/Right.

steps.label: Transition Setup2
steps.note:
To resolve, have the four purples spread North/sides Left->Right from their line spot as shown, & the stacks+blanks South Left->Right from their line spot. The first hands spawned will be your eventual safe spots, so each spot will need a pair of debuffs to safely spread [2x 1Purp/1Stack, 1x Purp/Purp]. 

Each pairing should then be L/R of their hand.

steps.label: Transition 1a
steps.note: The center is hit as Omega enters, & the second hands spawn. At this point the party should be standing on the inner edge of the *3rd* outer ring(Marked ring)

steps.label: Transition 1b
steps.note: The first Exa-Ring hits, & the party moves into it. (JP dodge)

steps.label: Transition 1c
steps.note: Stay in your relative positions as the first Exa-Ring set finishes.

steps.label: Transition 2a
steps.note: As soon as the last outer Exa-Rings finish, move back to the wall in your relative positions and be ready to dodge INTO 1st Hands after they explode.

steps.label: Transition 2b
steps.note:
As the first hands explode, move into yours whilst ALSO starting to JP dodge into the Exa-Ring. (Which'll be on the 2nd/3rd outer rings)

Stay by the edge of the 2nd hand explosion to leave sufficient space for the debuffs.

steps.label: Transition 2c
steps.note: Staying spread in the *2nd* outer ring, let debuffs resolve.

steps.label: Cast
steps.note:
After everything has resolved, move to middle in a loose spread before Omega starts casting 'Hello World'.

NOTE: Due to game limits, certain team comps will cap the status limit(incl.FC buffs) during Hello World. Take care to limit fc-buffs & jobs w/ extra buffs at this time.

steps.label: Hello World Setup1
steps.note:
Upon cast, everyone will recieve many debuffs, all starting with "Code Smells", which is simply a "Hold" to become the equivalent debuff on expiration. All Holds except Patches are 3s to give you time to spread/check what you have.

~~*Everyone* gets 1 Red-Green & 1 Blue Patch Holds, plus a 69sec Green "Stack" Marker. For our purposes, anyone w/o extra stuff will be "Blank" here.

~~When a Patch Hold nears release, a feint "ghost" tether will appear, indicating that it will soon appear.

~~Out goes 2 BlueDNAs, 2 BlueRots, 2 RedRots, a defamation on each of *either* the red OR blue rots, & a stack on each of the opposite rot, leaving 2 "Blanks".

-BigCircle - Defamation
-Diamond - BlueRot
-RotIcon - RedRot

**For the purposes of this toolbox, BlueRots will have Defamation/RedRots are Stacks

steps.label: Hello World Setup2
steps.note:
Before Towers start spawning, the smells will turn into their proper debuffs, with rots now active. (& colored indicators on rot players)

Everyone get ready to spot Towers to begin your movement.

-Defamation - RedCircle
-Stack(Pair) - Red3people
-BlueRot - Star
-RedRot - Pink Squares/Circles
-RG Hold - 2people w/ Red-Green tint
-Blue Hold - 2people w/ Blue tint


The shortest timer of each debuff will resolve in their necessary position. Said position is completely static, so all 4 pairs/8 players will eventually do each mechanic once.

steps.label: Hello World Towers1a
steps.note:
First Latent Defect Towers spawn, 2 red & 2 blue that sit next to each other. Positions for each role are as follows & as shown:

BlueDNA's will start with the shortest RG Hold, so stretch your ghost-tether across, standing near the called Defamation towers. (Blue in this case.)

Blanks will start with the shortest Blue Hold, so get in-between the non-Defamation towers.

RedRots have the Stack in this pattern, so they will soak their red towers on the inner edges, pairing up for stacks.

BlueRots have the Defamation in this pattern, so they'll soak their blue towers at max-melee.

steps.label: Hello World Towers1b
steps.note: As soon as everything goes off, the Defamation & RG-tether players will get together on their markers, passing rot onward. As well, the Blue-tether players will move into their stack partners, taking rot from them.

steps.label: Hello World Towers1c
steps.note: After that movement, the previous rots try to spread around (For the defamation rots they can stay on their marker for a moment), as the Blue-tether players pop theirs. The RG-tether players wait a moment for the vuln to wear off before breaking theirs.

steps.label: Hello World Towers1d
steps.note:
The initial rot-timers expire & AOE on each of the first players.

The next towers will soon appear, & the new rots will need to spot the (possibly) shifted towers for their color.

steps.label: Hello World Towers2a
steps.note: Second tower set spawns, & is resolved in the same way, w/ the redgreen ghost-tethers spread across the called Defamation towers, the Defamation-Rot players soaking their towers max-melee, & the Stack-Rots pairing up w/ the blue-ghost-tether players.

steps.label: Hello World Towers2b
steps.note: As soon as everything goes off, the Defamation & RG-tether players will get together on their markers, passing rot onward. As well, the Blue-tether players will move into their stack partners, taking rot from them.

steps.label: Hello World Towers2c
steps.note: After that movement, the previous rots try to spread around (For the defamation rots they can stay on their marker for a moment), as the Blue-tether players pop theirs. The RG-tether players wait a moment for the vuln to wear off before breaking theirs.

steps.label: Hello World Towers2d
steps.note:
The next rot-timers expire & AOE on each of the previous players.

The next towers will soon appear, & the new rots will need to spot the (possibly) shifted towers for their color.

steps.label: Hello World Towers3a
steps.note: Third tower set spawns, & is resolved in the same way, w/ the redgreen ghost-tethers spread across the called Defamation towers, the Defamation-Rot players soaking their towers max-melee, & the Stack-Rots pairing up w/ the blue-ghost-tether players.

steps.label: Hello World Towers3b
steps.note: As soon as everything goes off, the Defamation & RG-tether players will get together on their markers, passing rot onward. As well, the Blue-tether players will move into their stack partners, taking rot from them.

steps.label: Hello World Towers3c
steps.note: After that movement, the previous rots try to spread around (For the defamation rots they can stay on their marker for a moment), as the Blue-tether players pop theirs. The RG-tether players wait a moment for the vuln to wear off before breaking theirs.

steps.label: Hello World Towers3d
steps.note:
The next rot-timers expire & AOE on each of the previous players.

The final towers will soon appear, & the new rots will need to spot the (possibly) shifted towers for their color.

steps.label: Hello World Towers4a
steps.note:
Final tower set spawns, & is *mostly* resolved in the same way, w/ the Defamation-Rot players soaking their towers max-melee, & the Stack-Rots pairing up w/ the blue-ghost-tether players.

For this final set, the redgreen ghost-tethers will *also* get between the non-defamation towers, helping to soak the stacks, & ensuring their tether will pop instantly.

steps.label: Hello World Towers4b
steps.note:
As soon as everything goes off, the red-green tethers pop instantly, & the final Rot players simply spread away to await the last aoes.

Blue-tethers simply wait for vulns to fall off/heals to go out before popping theirs.

steps.label: Hello World Towers4c
steps.note: As the final rots finish spreading & vulns wear off, pop the last blue tether.

steps.label: Hello World Towers4d
steps.note:
The final rot-timers expire & AOE on each of the remaining players.

Omega will start to cast Critical Error, & the party will need to lineup.

steps.label: Lineup (LP)
steps.note: Upon finishing Critical Error, players should get to mid & heal up, then lineup in the same order as Transition, now N->S like shown, slightly off the boss.

steps.label: Lineup (Opti)
steps.note:
An optimized N->S lineup for ranged baits & melee positionals.

HHRRTTMM, Group1 then Group2

The positioning slides after this will assume LP lineup from before.

steps.label: Oversampled Setup1
steps.note: Omega will give 3 players an "Oversampled Wave Cannon Loading" debuff, to be used next.

steps.label: Oversampled Setup2
steps.note:
Oversampled sets up 3 Wave Cannon/Monitor debuffs & casts Wave Cannon/Monitors itself.

Monitors target *2* players on the side faced w/ an AOE, so we'll need to setup player cleaves w/ boss cleave to hit each player w/ 1 AOE. The glowing marker-side is the side cleaved/to face.

Using the previous positions, going from North->South count your debuff 1-3. For the blank players, fill out open spots per the next page.

steps.label: Oversampled Setup3
steps.note:
Since the boss will *always* cleave either East or West, we have the 1st debuff player always North, at either NW/NE(In the boss cleave), on the inner-corner of the marker.

The second player will go SW/SE in the boss cleave, also on the inner-mark corner. The third player will take the opposite South corner & sit *directly South* of the marker. The cleave lines should cut through the arena like so.

The remaining players simply fill the open spots shown here 1-5/proximity.
